brand.name: Easy Pay Direct
brand.description: Payment processing infrastructure for over 100,000 merchants across 13+ years.

colors.__note__: Colors are strictly role-based. Text on dark backgrounds is always the two lightest neutrals (#EBEDF6 or #D1D8E7). Never use a blue as text on a blue background. Never use #000914 as text on any dark surface.

workflow.__note__: Generate the background scene with an image model, then composite real brand assets on top with scripts/composite.py. Image models cannot reproduce logos, motifs, UI, or product mockups pixel-perfect, so those elements must always be pasted from the source files. See AGENTS.md for full details.
steps: Step 1: Generate a background scene with reserved empty regions. Tell the model NOT to draw logos, motifs, UI, or product mockups. Leave specific empty regions (top for logo, side edges for motif, content well for graphic).

assets.__motif_note__: EPD's motif is a nested rounded-diamond family. It must always be pasted from the source files (SVG or transparent PNG) onto the background, never redrawn by an image model. Use scripts/composite.py in this repo to do that pasting. Never attach these files as references to an image model, because it will paraphrase the shape and break brand fidelity.

motif_hero.description: Concentric rounded-diamond outlines fading up from the bottom. Homepage-hero style.
recommended_for: 9:16 social where copy sits above the motif

motif_side_right.description: A single large nested rounded-diamond outline anchored to the RIGHT edge, spilling in from the right.
recommended_for: section backgrounds where copy sits on the left

motif_side_left.description: Nested rounded-diamond outlines anchored to the LEFT edge. Mirror of side-right, for compositions where content sits on the right.
recommended_for: section backgrounds where copy sits on the right
wide banners with content on the right

motif_side_both.description: True symmetric motif: nested rounded-diamond outlines mirrored on BOTH left and right edges with a clean center gap for content.
recommended_for: any layout where the motif frames symmetrically

motif_side_right_on_brand_blue.description: Right-anchored motif tuned for the lighter #003C7E brand-blue section background.

assets.__approved_graphics_note__: These are pre-approved brand graphics that MUST be composited from the source files, never generated by an image model. Use scripts/composite.py --graphic <key> to add one on top of a generated background.

approved_graphic_dashboard_card_donut_co.description: Full composite of revenue donut + product/subscription cards + credit card on transparent background. Best for wide banners with content on the left.

approved_graphic_credit_card_mockup.description: Standalone dark navy EPD credit card mockup with chip, tap indicator, and cardholder name.

approved_graphic_credit_card_wave.description: Light-theme card + wave line + gradient. Best for lighter section backgrounds.

approved_graphic_metrics_card_revenue.description: Revenue-by-plan donut card on mid-blue. Best as a standalone data-viz element.

approved_graphic_net_sales_breakdown.description: Net Sales Breakdown waterfall chart (YTD). Light theme. Blue positive bars, warm red/orange deduction bars for discounts/refunds/chargebacks, blue Net Sales final bar. Use on light pages to show financial breakdown or revenue math.

approved_graphic_retry_success.description: Retry Success bar chart (YTD) showing success rate across Attempt #1-5. Light theme, blue bars. Use for pages about revenue recovery, retry logic, or account updater features.

approved_graphic_average_order_value.description: Average Order Value line/area chart (YTD, Jan-Dec) with big $50.27 headline number. Light theme, blue area fill. Use for pages about AOV, trending metrics, or seasonal analytics.

approved_graphic_top_failure_reasons.description: Top Failure Reasons horizontal bar chart (YTD): Insufficient Funds, Card Declined, Expired Card, Card Reported Lost, Technical Error, Other. Light theme, blue bars. Use for pages about decline analytics, chargeback reduction, or risk mitigation.

approved_graphic_products_dashboard.description: Full EPD Commerce Products page UI screenshot. Left dark navy sidebar with nav items (Dashboard, Products, Landing Pages, etc.), main content area with 3 KPI cards (Total products, Product revenue, Product sold) and a product catalog table. Use as a product-UI reference or hero screenshot.

approved_graphic_partnership_blueprint.description: Blueprint-style diagram showing two nested rounded-diamond nodes (Partner and Easy Pay Direct) connected by four labeled channels (Revenue share, Referrals, Co-marketing, Operations) on a subtle grid. Use on partnership, integration, or how-we-work pages. Light theme.

approved_graphic_epd_commerce_hero.description: EPD Commerce mobile dashboard mockup. Phone showing the Dashboard view with Net revenue, Products sold, and Revenue chart, plus floating Sales and New subscriptions cards. Light theme, transparent-friendly background. Use on EPD Commerce product pages, launch collateral, and any creative that needs to show the mobile app UI.

logo_white.description: Primary horizontal lockup, white version. Use on any dark background.

logo_dark.description: Primary horizontal lockup, navy version. Use on any light background.

palette_swatch.description: Labeled palette image. Attach to any image generation call so the model matches actual EPD colors.

typography_specimen.description: Specimen of General Sans + DM Mono at real display, body, and mono sizes.

example_hero.description: Real easypaydirect.com homepage hero. Attach as a positive style reference for any marketing image on the site or a similar layout.

example_section_hero_with_phone.description: Real EPD hero section with phone mockup, showing the both-edges motif framing the content symmetrically.

example_section_testimonials.description: Real EPD testimonials section using the right-edge motif variant (variant B). Shows canonical wide-section treatment with the motif spilling in from the right.

example_section_pricing.description: Real EPD pricing section on the lighter #003C7E brand blue with the both-edges variant D. Shows how the motif is tuned for lighter navy backgrounds.

example_section_application_form.description: Real EPD merchant application form section with the both-edges motif framing content in the middle.

example_social_graphic.description: Real EPD LinkedIn banner (wide 4:1 style). Attach as a positive style reference for wide social banners.

example_social_squares.description: Two real EPD 1:1 square social examples side by side. Left: imagery-driven with people. Right: dashboard-driven. Both use the motif to frame the composition.

example_social_square.description: A finished 1:1 EPD ad with the side motif on the right, headline and CTA on the left, dashboard mockup on the right, and three green-check bullet points. Attach as a positive style reference for 1:1 social crops.

motif_dos_and_donts.description: Reference sheet showing valid motif placements (all four variants A, B, C, D) alongside failure modes (invented diamond shape, high opacity, recolored). Attach when generating any image with the motif.
